notes: Dry-run boundary: the transaction step skips ONLY clickSaveAndSubmit (the sole irreversible UCPath mutation). All upstream steps — CRM extraction, PDF download, UCPath person-search, and I9 profile creation — still execute. I9 creation is search-first (idempotent by SSN), so dry-run does not create duplicate profiles.
Rehire short-circuit: if person-search finds an existing UCPath record (searchResult.found=true), the handler stamps rehire:Yes + existingEmplIds and returns before i9-creation and transaction steps.

Pool/batch mode: archetype='batch', batch.mode='pool', poolSize=4. Each worker claims one email at a time from the shared SQLite tasks queue. The handler runs per-email with 3 browsers (CRM, UCPath, I9) and 2 Duo MFA challenges per worker (I9 SSO has no Duo).
PDF download (pdf-download step) is non-fatal: failure is caught, logged, and stamped as pdfDownload:'Failed:...' without interrupting UCPath/I9 phases.

SSN format inconsistency across systems: UCPath person-search and UCPath personalData.nationalId both expect 9 digits no dashes; I9 search expects dashes (123-45-6789); I9 profile create also expects 9 digits no dashes.

Retry idempotency gap: the transaction step's Smart HR submit has no duplicate-guard probe (unlike separations' findExistingTerminationTransaction). Operators retrying onboarding must manually confirm no pending hire exists in UCPath before clicking Retry.
